english.meaning: a long time ago; already early on
english.note: 一早就 means already, ages ago.

exampleSentences.english: When I first heard someone was making *New Shanghai Bund*, I made *New New Shanghai Bund* to mess with you. How about that? I wouldn’t use that trick anymore.
exampleSentences.traditional: 一早聽人做《新上海灘》嘅時候，我就做個《新新上海灘》搞你。噉有冇？都唔會用哩招喇。
